model_annotation: The figure contains two stacked line plots showing training rewards as a function of training steps for two methods on an “Easy Training Set” (top) and a “Hard Training Set” (bottom). In both plots, the x-axis is labeled “Steps” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with major tick labels at 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, and 500. In the top plot (“Easy Training Set”), the y-axis is labeled “Training Rewards” on a linear scale with labeled ticks at 0.0, 0.2, and 0.4 (the plotted range extending slightly above 0.4). Two solid lines without markers are shown: a blue line labeled “Llama-On-Policy-Easy” that starts near 0 at step 0, rises to roughly 0.25–0.30 by around 100 steps, then fluctuates around the low-to-mid 0.3s through 500 steps (ending around ~0.35); and a red line labeled “Llama-LUFFY-Easy” that also starts near 0, increases to roughly the mid 0.2s by around 100 steps, then continues with small oscillations while trending into the upper 0.3s by the end (ending around ~0.40 near step 500). In the bottom plot (“Hard Training Set”), the y-axis is labeled “Training Rewards” on a linear scale with labeled ticks at 0.0, 0.1, and 0.2 (with the plotted range extending slightly above 0.2). Two solid lines without markers are shown: a blue line labeled “Llama-On-Policy-Hard” that begins slightly above 0 at step 0 (around a few hundredths), then drops toward 0 by roughly 50–100 steps and stays near 0 for the remainder of the x-range; and a red line labeled “Llama-LUFFY-Hard” that starts near 0, rises to around ~0.10 by about 100 steps, continues upward with fluctuations around ~0.12–0.17 through the mid-range, and reaches just above 0.20 by approximately step 500.
